affix.isekai_mahou.depths.vampiric.desc: monsters heal when they hurt you
affix.isekai_mahou.depths.volatile.desc: monsters burst when they die — step back
announce.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.d: *the giant collapses, and the cave finally falls silent*
announce.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.i: *the whole earth shakes... something huge has awoken*
announce.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.p: *the ground fills with small tremors — the brood awakens*
*the ceiling groans; stones begin to fall*
announce.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.s: *burrowing worms crawl out of the earth!*
bestiary.isekai_mahou.depths_burrower.de: A larva of the depths. It dives into the ground and bites from below. After surfacing, it takes a while to dig again.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.depths_lost_delver: An adventurer who never came back. Its helmet lamp still blinds whoever stares at it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.d: A tower-sized worm that devours mana geodes — the crystals grew into its own shell. It vanishes underground and bursts out beneath its prey.
boss_entrance.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_k: The One Who Devours the Earth
command.isekai_mahou.depths.geode_fail: The geode didn't fit here (water, lava or bedrock in the way).
command.isekai_mahou.depths.not_found: No Layered Dungeon found nearby (only chunks generated after v1.6 have them).
command.isekai_mahou.depths.puzzle_demo: Demo puzzle room (%s) built in front of you.
command.isekai_mahou.depths.puzzle_none: No loaded Rune Seal nearby (or demo template missing).
command.isekai_mahou.depths.record: Best time: %s · dungeons cleared: %s · current descent: %s
command.isekai_mahou.depths.spawn_fail: Could not summon the boss here.
command.isekai_mahou.depths.tp: Teleported to the Layered Dungeon at %s %s %s.
command.isekai_mahou.depths.where: Current dungeon floor: %s (-1 = outside; 0 = entrance; 5 = nest).
hint.isekai_mahou.depths_affixes: Each floor has affixes that change its monsters (they rotate every 7 days). More affixes, a bit more XP.
hint.isekai_mahou.depths_puzzle: Puzzle room: touch the Rune Seal for a tip. Solve it and the grate around the chest vanishes.
item.isekai_mahou.depths_dragonslayer.de: Too big to be called a sword. Thick, heavy, rough — a heap of raw iron.
item.isekai_mahou.depths_dragonslayer.pa: Full swings cleave in an arc. +50% vs bosses and giants. Heavy: −10% speed.
item.isekai_mahou.depths_dragonslayer.us: Hold 1 s and release: Black Swordsman's Cleave — 200° arc, 16 damage and knockback (10 s).
item.isekai_mahou.depths_goddess_knife.d: Forged for a single adventurer: it grows along with them.
item.isekai_mahou.depths_goddess_knife.f: Falna: +%s damage (grows with your level and Circle)
item.isekai_mahou.depths_goddess_knife.u: Hold and release: Argonaut — charge up to 3 s; your next hit deals +50% per second (12 s).
item.isekai_mahou.depths_pure_mana_shard: Mana so concentrated it turned to stone. Rare in geodes and the depths.
Use: restores 40% of max mana (30 s cooldown).
Hard as diamond, still warm. Smiths would pay fortunes for it.
item.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king_spawn: Worm King of the Depths Spawn Egg
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.enter.hint: Look for a ruin with a well and a ladder (forests, plains, hills). Follow the journal compass and climb down.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.enter.lore: The sign says: those who descend don't always return.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.floor3.hint: Each floor has a way down in the corner opposite the arrival. Beware of pressure plates: they are arrow traps.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.floor3.lore: The Crystal Mines hold a grotto with a Budding Mana Crystal.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.geode.hint: Giant blue crystal geodes appear deep underground (y −56 to 20). Break a Mana Cluster.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.geode.lore: Clusters drop Mana Crystals and sometimes a Pure Mana Shard.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.intro: Ruins with a dark well appear across forests and plains. They say a layered dungeon lies below — and a tower-sized worm sleeps at the bottom.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.lore: Each floor is more dangerous than the last, with traps, monster spawners and mimics. In exchange, the chests grow richer and richer.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.outro: The Worm King has fallen. The depths remain below — but now they are yours.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.puzzle.hint: Every dungeon floor (and also the Demon Citadel, the End Library and the Dwarven City) has a puzzle room. Touch the Rune Seal for a tip; once solved, the grate around the chest vanishes.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.puzzle.lore: Levers, plates, mirrors and runes: the ancients liked to test the wits of those who entered.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.title: The Depths
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.treasure: Wield a treasure of the depths
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.treasure.hin: The Dragonslayer and the Goddess Knife drop from the Worm King, appear in the deepest chests, or are forged from its Fang.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.treasure.lor: One is too big; the other grows with you.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.worm_king: Defeat the Worm King of the Depths
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.worm_king.hi: In the nest below Floor 4. Run from the marked circles when it dives and strike when it surfaces. Kill the larvae.
journal.isekai_mahou.depths.worm_king.lo: Mana crystals grew on its shell.
message.isekai_mahou.depths.entered: You entered the Layered Dungeon. The deeper you go, the better the treasure — and the worse its guardians.
message.isekai_mahou.depths.geode: A Mana Geode! Look for the Budding Crystal: with Silk Touch you can take the source home.
Each lever flips some lamps. Light them all.
Turn the mirrors (right-click) until the light hits the lamp.
The seal sleeps: puzzle pieces are missing nearby.
Watch the order of the runes, then touch them in that order.
Light every plate without stepping on one twice or leaving the grid.
message.isekai_mahou.depths.puzzle.reset: The plates went dark — start over.
message.isekai_mahou.depths.puzzle.solve: Seal broken! The grate has opened.
message.isekai_mahou.depths.run.done: Worm King defeated! Descent time: %s (your record: %s).
message.isekai_mahou.depths.run.record: Worm King defeated in %s — NEW RECORD!
message.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.bu: While buried it can't be hurt — run from the marked circle and strike when it surfaces!
message.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.er: The marked ground will burst: leave the circle!
message.isekai_mahou.depths_worm_king.la: Burrowing Worms bite from below — kill them while they're above ground.
